method: Ran the registered four-check verifier against the W6 master ID list, current lesson tracker, design/spec status documents, and latest progress entry. No provider or network calls.

observations.trace: The master W6 list contains 102 unique lesson IDs (102/144, 70.83%), with 42 remaining; evaluation/provider-migration appears once and every listed ID resolves in the tracker.

limitations: This verifier checks count and document consistency only; it does not independently establish the quality of any lesson review.
